name: Wisp Walk
mix: Two shields: Focus runs out, so win with Great Counters, not just Strikes.
legend: # = wall, . = floor, P = player start, D = door slot (in the outer wall), C = chest, S = rest shrine
waves_note: Enemies arrive in waves: the next wave comes when 1 enemy (or none) is left.
artProps: Layout copied from twin-shields. Theme and props from the summit draft room "wisp-walk". A walkway lined with tiny floating lights; rain-dark flagstones.
signs: Little lights dance in the wind.
